old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a pot of water boiling on a stovetop. The pot is black with a silver interior and has a black handle. It sits on a burner that is glowing red, indicating it is turned on and heating the water. The water inside the pot is vigorously bubbling, with numerous small bubbles rising to the surface, creating a dynamic and lively scene. Steam rises from the pot, adding to the sense of heat and activity. The background shows part of the stovetop, which appears slightly worn, with some stains visible. There are no other objects or characters in the frame, focusing entirely on the boiling water and the pot. The camera remains stationary throughout the video, maintaining a consistent angle and distance from the pot, allowing viewers to observe the continuous boiling process without any interruptions or changes in perspective.

caption: The video captures a close-up, slightly high-angle view of a saucepan filled with water at a rolling boil. The pan has a blue outer wall, a stainless steel rim, and a black handle projecting to the right, resting on an electric burner with a faint red glow visible beneath it. A dark skillet sits on an adjacent burner in the upper-left background against a cream-colored stovetop. Throughout, the water churns continuously, with bubbles forming, rising, and bursting across the entire surface without any calm interval. Steam and haze rise above the pot, their drifting pattern shifting continuously. A small greenish fleck appears intermittently near the center of the boiling surface as the water moves. The pot, handle, burner, and background skillet remain fixed in place, with no object entering, exiting, or being manipulated. Only minor handheld jitter shifts the framing slightly, and the boiling proceeds steadily throughout the visible segment.
